friendly_name: Runtime status readers through the read door
purpose_context: The runtime decision path behind spec-kitty next still reads work-package status through an older path that misses status committed on the coordination branch, so a coordination Mission whose coordination checkout is empty reports no actionable work and zero progress (#7507). This Mission moves those readers onto the one status read door that the rest of the CLI already uses (#7310), keeps owned-checkout and coordination safety refusals where the operator ruled they belong, and adds an opt-in way for next to set up a missing coordination checkout itself.
purpose_tldr: Make spec-kitty next and its status queries read Mission status from one declared source, so a coordination Mission never shows an empty board while its lanes are committed.
